method: Inspected the 33 pinned original score pages covering the 46 v2 disagreements and consulted the 1725 primary text. These are evidence-backed issue classifications, not an independent certification of every note in the complete corpus. No rule reads this ledger to exempt a figure ID. Unsettled inflections and simultaneous dissonances remain visible.
